messages:
lexi (marketing): fyi ran a regional webinar spike test (APAC + EMEA) — 2 regional bursts ~800/min each. saw ~5% fallthrough overall but APAC had 9% fallthrough.

omar (ops): APAC higher — likely mapping to default owner in SF because our owner-pools are US-centric, plus enrichment TTLs mismatched to vendor latency in that region. logs show enrichment 95p APAC 1.8s, claim TTL 1.2s.

dee (growth): so regional latency + RR mapping = bad combo. can we add geo-aware warm pools (apac-warm, emeawarm) and a campaign flag to prefer regional pools?

samir (sales-ops): yes. sample SF routing rule: IF campaign.geo = 'APAC' AND campaign.metadata.high_volume = true THEN owner = 'apac-warm' ELSE normal_rr(). also need dedupe on enrichment callback to avoid duplicate creates.

omar (ops): quick code change proposal: bump enrichment_ttl to 2s for region=APAC when campaign.high_volume=true, add soft_hold_ms=400 when enrichment_queue_depth>45, route to region-warm pool if still pending. instrument metrics: fallthrough_by_region, enrichment_latency_by_region.

lexi (marketing): marketing will add campaign.metadata.high_volume and campaign.geo to webinar templates. also flag which events are global so growth can toggle region routing.

dee (growth): can we have a campaign-level override in UI? want to enable warm-pool per event.

samir (sales-ops): I'll draft the SF rule PR and add runbook steps for SDR owners (apac-warm = APAC SDR rotation). include dedupe guidance.

omar (ops): I'll open a small PR to implement soft_hold & geo-warm routing and add the regional metrics. plan: staging canary tomorrow 10% for APAC traffic only.

deploy-bot: deploy queued by omar tag: inbound-geo-warm-2026-03. rollout plan: APAC canary 10% -> 60% -> 100% with 20m window. health check = APAC fallthrough < 2.5%

lexi (marketing): followups: dashboard card per-campaign + per-region fallthrough; add to webinar runbook: "enable region-warm and increase TTL for that region if fallthrough > 2%". thanks team.
